summary: Completed testing of Diabetes Registration Form feature and Face ID camera permission handling. All backend APIs working correctly (11/11 tests passed). Frontend components verified - DiabetesFormPublic page and GlydexStaffPortal Send Form Link dialog working as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: FaceBiometric.jsx has excellent camera permission handling with checkCameraPermission() function, multiple fallback constraints, and comprehensive error handling for all camera error types
seed_data_creation: Created multiple test diabetes forms during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Diabetes Form feature fully tested. APIs: POST /api/glydex/form/send, GET /api/glydex/form/{form_id}, POST /api/glydex/form/{form_id}/submit, GET /api/glydex/forms/list. Frontend: DiabetesFormPublic page at /diabetes-form/:formId, GlydexStaffPortal with Send Form Link button in Diabetes Patients tab.

send_form.description: Creates form record, sends email/SMS with form link

get_form.description: Returns form details with patient info, status (allotted/filled)

submit_form.description: Submits filled form, changes status to 'filled'

list_forms.description: Lists all forms with counts (total, allotted, filled)

diabetes_form_public_page.submitted_form_view: Shows 'Form Submitted!' success message with reference number

features_verified: Send Form Link button opens dialog
Dialog has Patient Name, Phone, Email inputs
Send Via options: SMS Only, Email Only, Both
Diabetes Form Status section shows form list with status badges
Form counts: Forms Sent, Pending, Filled

improvements: checkCameraPermission() function checks permission status before camera access
Multiple fallback constraints for better mobile compatibility
Comprehensive error handling for all camera error types
User-friendly error messages with instructions to enable camera
